result.summary: Expands BIP30 functional test coverage in `feature_block.py` to test duplicate non-coinbase transactions. It verifies that re-including a duplicate regular transaction is rejected while its outputs remain unspent and accepted once they are spent.
result.problem: BIP30 validation applies to all transactions in a block to prevent overwriting existing unspent transaction outputs, but the functional tests only exercised duplicate coinbase transactions. A mutation restricting BIP30 enforcement to coinbases alone was not caught by the test suite.
evidence: Kills mutant 4389 (https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4389), which modified `ConnectBlock` in `validation.cpp` to only check BIP30 on `block.vtx[0]` instead of iterating over all transactions.
result.card: Expands BIP30 functional testing in feature_block.py to cover duplicate non-coinbase transactions. Previously, test coverage only exercised duplicate coinbases, leaving consensus enforcement against duplicate regular transactions untested. The author demonstrates that this test kills a consensus-validation mutation that restricted BIP30 checks exclusively to coinbases.

risk.why: A flaw would only produce test failures or false test passes without affecting node runtime or consensus logic.
